hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM backed by Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes via a custom curve invariant, takes input tokens from the PoolManager, deposits them into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and settles — completely replacing the standard x*y=k pool math with its own reserve-based pricing.
